latestVersion.changelog:
agile-pm-workflow-modular 1.0.0

- Initial release of a modular Agile PM workflow tool.
- Automatically recommends essential and optional workflow modules based on project type and constraints.
- Users can confirm or adjust recommended modules before execution.
- Provides a comprehensive module library covering B端/C端项目、功能迭代、技术、数据等多元场景。
- Focuses on minimizing unnecessary documentation and tailoring output to value and context.
